title: Measurement & Motion
summary: How do we measure the world, and describe how things move? From handspans to metres, from swings to speeding trains, this unit builds the tools of physics: measurement, speed, graphs and time.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Accurate measurement and clear representations such as graphs help us describe, compare and predict motion.

factual: Why do we need standard units?
What are the different types of motion?
conceptual: How does a distance–time graph tell the story of a journey?
How can a swinging pendulum be used to measure time?
debatable: Should India lower speed limits on highways to improve safety?
